Monday.title: Monday • Lower + Push
Monday.focus: Strength + muscle • manage Monday leg fatigue
Monday.notes: Keep the main lower-body work controlled so Wednesday yoga and Friday/Saturday training remain productive.
exercises: Start around a repeatable working weight; progress only when reps/RIR support it.
Primary horizontal press. Use barbell as the main bench pattern.
Controlled eccentric; aim to build toward 135 lb again.
Moderate volume; don't turn Monday into a second maximal hinge day.

Wednesday.title: Wednesday • Yoga / Recovery
Wednesday.notes: Keep it restorative/moderate. Monitor whether Monday leg DOMS interferes with yoga.

Friday.title: Friday • Upper + Pull
Friday.notes: Avoid unnecessary lower-body fatigue before Saturday.
exercises: Progress with reps first; don't chase old powerlifting numbers during the fat-loss phase.
Use as the main vertical pull if pull-ups aren't ready for full volume.
Add time gradually; quality grip and shoulder position.

Saturday.title: Saturday • Legs + Athletic
Saturday.notes: This is the leg day you were logging in Strong. Keep heavy squatting here moderate if Monday is the main squat stimulus.
exercises: You have used 25 lb DBs; progress based on form and RIR.
Use a load you can control without grinding.
Optional on weeks when Monday soreness/recovery is poor.
Prior sessions suggest 60 lb total felt appropriate; adjust by RIR.
Short finisher if grip is fresh.
